about: CropLytics field registry. One entry per real field (DWR / Land IQ 2023 outline, CDL-checked). Read with backend/fields/fieldreg.py. family picks the rotation set (rice -> CAR0-CAR3 from car_colusa_rice, forage -> CAF0-CAF3 from caf_tulare_forage) and the trained ML calendar model (template). weather_point is the POWER/NOAA request point (null = polygon centroid). ncei_stations null = chosen by backend/regional fetch_ncei.py (nearest 3 with >=70% coverage) and written back here. reservoirs are the CDEC storage stations shown for the field. water is filled by backend/fields/water_sources.py from public boundary layers. fields_other_regions holds fields outside California (region 'bc'), read only when asked for (fieldreg region=None or 'bc', or FIELDSHIFT_FIELDS); they carry not_available reasons instead of the California-only lookups.

fields_other_regions.name: Salmon River valley forage field (Shuswap, BC)
fields_other_regions.farmer_name: Hay field in the Salmon River valley, 10 km southwest of downtown Salmon Arm

county.name: Columbia-Shuswap
county.code_system: Statistics Canada SGC census division (59 = BC)

fields_other_regions.why: BC example: the lower Salmon River was under the 16 Aug 2023 fish population protection order that stopped about 398 licence holders irrigating forage. AAFC classes this outline Pasture / Forages in every mapped year 2014-2025. Built on non-reserve farmland (6.5 km from the nearest reserve); see docs/bc-first-nations.md.

water_context.watershed: Salmon River (Shuswap), lower reach; Bessette Creek is the other 2023 order area

orders.title: Fish population protection orders M0238_2023 (lower Salmon River) and M0239_2023 (Bessette Creek): about 398 licence holders to stop using water for forage crops

water_context.note: No California-style water district or SGMA basin. Surface and groundwater licences are issued by the Province under the Water Sustainability Act; this field's licence is not looked up (the lookup would identify an owner).

not_available.openet: OpenET covers the western United States only; there is no field-scale measured water use for BC.
not_available.cimis: CIMIS is California's station network; BC has two ECCC climate stations near this field (one closed in 2021).
not_available.insurance: USDA RMA crop-insurance records cover the United States only; BC Production Insurance loss data is not public at field or county level.
not_available.sgma: SGMA, water districts and CDEC reservoirs are California institutions; BC water licensing is not integrated.
not_available.cdl: No USDA Cropland Data Layer in Canada; AAFC's Annual Crop Inventory is used instead (one Pasture / Forages class, no alfalfa class).
not_available.soil_survey: No field-scale soil API in BC like SSURGO; SoilGrids v2 (a 250 m global model) is used instead.
not_available.outlook: The coming-season outlooks (NOAA CPC, US Drought Monitor, CDEC) are US products; not built for BC.
not_available.ml_calendar: The machine-learning calendar and stress models were trained on California fields and were not run here.
